repo_notes.content: VS Code extension (TypeScript) for Jekyll ImgFlow — editor integration for the jekyll-imgflow gem's image optimization tags. Published to Open VSX, not the VS Code Marketplace.
Build: esbuild/tsc compile src/ -> out/; js-yaml is bundled to parse _config.yml (node_modules ships in the VSIX for it).

vsce rejects SVG badge URLs in packaged READMEs — npm run package generates a sanitized README via scripts/prepare-vsix-readme.mjs (single packaging transform; never maintain a second committed README).

Key pins: @types/vscode must match engines.vscode minimum (1.91.0); mocha stays v11 (EDH harness is CJS, mocha 12 is ESM-only); typescript stays v6 (v7/tsgo needs deliberate evaluation). .npmrc min-release-age=7 avoids fresh supply-chain releases.

Release: npm version patch -> push v* tag -> publish.yml re-runs integration matrix, packages VSIX, creates GitHub release, publishes to Open VSX (needs OVSX_PAT secret). CHANGELOG entry matching the tag is a hard gate.
See AGENTS.md for build commands, test tiers (Vitest unit + @vscode/test-electron integration), and conventions.
